adoption.reason: Retrospective ablation does not establish prospective improvement or a general cycle law

cycleAblation.componentAblationMeaning: Remove only the additive cycle displacement in log price. The illustrative residual remains shared; this is not an independently trained no-cycle model.
cycleAblation.originRule: Last at most 12 completed month ends after the required published valuation source existed; at least one 30-day outcome must be mature.
cycleAblation.timingHypothesisStatus: Not a test of universal 3–5-month cycle acceleration. Event definitions and more distinct completed market cycles are required.

scope: Locked retrospective experiments on the available current-source price series. No prospective validation, probability guarantee or model promotion is claimed.

reasons: No matured prospective trial for this candidate
Current-source retrospective data cannot establish historical vintage performance

sequential.baselineInterval: Fixed normal 80% band using only the previous 180 daily log returns and square-root-time scaling; an assumption, not guaranteed coverage.
sequential.candidateDefinition: The fixed shrunken log trend is multiplied by 1 / (1 + sd30 / sd180); no parameter is optimized on evaluation outcomes.
